title: Janax y Razar: un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador propios para un razonamiento artificial que piensa con melodías
description:
Janax is a hand-written operating system, language and assembler (all in assembly, no third-party engines) built to host Razar, an artificial reasoning system whose single judge is compression (two-part MDL). Version 0.13 (versions follow prime numbers), Luma looks and grows: (1) a camera with meaning: attention goes where the MDL judge measures something new (a kept piece, a body that changes, a birth), zooming in on the event and back out when nothing is new; (2) bodies that change: when a creature learns, its body (a recipe in Razar's organ alphabet) tries every one-letter mutation and keeps the best only if its cost does not rise; it grows with the bits it learned and slowly shrinks when it learns nothing; (3) feedback between forms and bodies, which share one alphabet, judged both ways against a shuffled control (pre-registered): the bridge exists but no offer won in either direction; Luma's forms sit at an optimum no body recipe improves. A body keeping a mutation when it learns: 5 of 7 (predicted to fail). Always awake: ~9.5% of a core; the home grows ~110-140 MB per hour. Independent archive replay: 0 mismatches. OS test suite: 402 passed, 0 failed. Documentation is in Spanish.

Janax es un sistema operativo, un idioma y un ensamblador escritos a mano en assembler, hechos para alojar a Razar. v0.13: Luma mira y crece — cámara con sentido, cuerpos que cambian y un puente entre formas y cuerpos que todavía nadie cruzó. Prototipo de investigación.
